data.text: I’m with Kate—I’ll commit to 10 tons under an equal agreement. Luke, you deserve a living here too; there’s no need to buy your place by sitting out. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next month, and a combined limit of 50 tons does that while supporting all five of us. Let’s check our catches together each month and adjust if the lake falls below 100. John, can you agree to 10 tons as well?
